label: Web platforms: Marketplace, Marketing, Services Platform, Identity, Rewards and Support, plus Conversational AI, Uvation Pulse, Atlas CRM, Devops and Design Marketing Development Collab
note: Web-Marketplace Product Catalog (PC) is reported with Web-Marketplace, because the AI-server catalogue work runs across both boards.

programmes.name: Web-Marketplace
programmes.headline: On 12 Nov the Magento 2.4.9 upgrade reached production: b.kumar closed the Marketplace production upgrade on the Devops board (IN-1255), and the upgrade stories (MT-1615, MT-1753), the core upgrade (MT-1617) and 48 items that were waiting at Ready For Prod moved to Done, together with 27 more Uvation module compatibility checks and the front-end and back-end regression tests (MT-1739, MT-1740). Only the store credit checkout bug (MT-1778) is still Ready For Prod. Naman Bapna, Naveen Jangid, Parth and shubham kuchwar raised 48 follow-up items, mostly due 30 Nov: in-house Store Credit and RMA modules to replace Mirasvit (MT-1795 to MT-1812), a Magento admin sales dashboard for quotes and orders (MT-1802, MT-1817 to MT-1829, due 16 to 27 Nov), removal of unused third-party modules (MT-1803, MT-1814 to MT-1816, MT-1830 to MT-1833) and an in-house AI Agent connector (MT-1834 to MT-1840). The 15 November go-live checklist (MT-1770, due 13 Nov) is still in progress, and four of its checks are open past 4 and 5 Nov (MT-1772, MT-1774, MT-1776; Communication Hub, MT-1777, has no date). 22 items are past due, down from 62.

programmes.name: Web-Marketing
programmes.headline: On 12 Nov Kannan Elangovan moved the People, Careers and Products page updates, the v1.3 Kimi page and the Communication Hub login error into Dev Testing (MR-1399, MR-1401, MR-1408, MR-1470, MR-1485), and Kunal Jangid moved the homepage, Project Genesis, Partners and SLA page updates to Code Review (MR-1381, MR-1400, MR-1402, MR-1404) and started the About and Contact page fixes (MR-1477 to MR-1487). Kunal Jangid now owns the second v1.2 story (MR-1411). New work was raised: a uvation-cms API hardening story to close data-leak and abuse routes (MR-1488, Vishnu kumar yadav, with nine subtasks due 17 to 25 Nov), three marketing front-end stories on JavaScript size, image optimisation and SonarCloud (MR-1498, MR-1504, MR-1510, Kunal Jangid, due 30 Nov), and a design validation bug with 13 homepage, Project Genesis and SLA page issues (MR-1516 to MR-1529). The v1.2 revamp (MR-1379) is due 13 Nov. 30 items are past due, unchanged.

programmes.name: Web-Uvation Services Platform
programmes.headline: On 12 Nov Silviu Oltean deployed the ACS chat events webhook to Dev with its authentication and APIM route (USP-4441 to USP-4444) and added bell notifications and UAT and production set-up for the hub notifications (USP-4460 to USP-4462). Between 3 and 10 Nov Silviu Oltean closed the Support Hub deploy preparations, v1 fixes, request reassignment and status messages (USP-4228, USP-4253, USP-4332, USP-4333) and the chat events webhook (USP-4431), and deployed Support Hub v2 and auto-assignment to Dev (USP-4252, USP-4331). Livian Stefan Stan closed the front-end polish, whole-portal responsive and design audit work (USP-4351, USP-4354 to USP-4356), started the Communication Hub re-skin and Support Hub mobile (USP-4295, USP-4329), and deployed to Dev the payment messages, maximum deposit, Proposal wording and four new AI Factory Contract Proposal and feature-flag stories (USP-4292, USP-4401, USP-4433, USP-4450 to USP-4453, due 15 Nov). Cășvan Marcel closed the management networking block (USP-4413), and set the unpaid and overdue invoice state to Won't Do (USP-4291). 14 items moved to 31 Dec, including the pricing-rule eval security bug (USP-4414) and the NetSuite export bug (USP-4415); ten more moved to 30 Nov, including Book a meeting (USP-4298), and seven to 15 Dec. Still open: the S1 Document API 502 (USP-4231, TODO, due 15 Nov) and the Highest seat-claims security bug (USP-4369, Deployed In Dev, due 15 Nov). The Payments and Invoicing and Dashboard go-live epics passed their 2 and 8 Nov dates in TODO (USP-4280, USP-4336). 77 items are past due, down from 139.

programmes.name: Uvation Conversational AI
programmes.headline: On 12 Nov 32 of Shivam Dhoundiyal's front-end widget, dashboard and console stories (UC-242 to UC-274) were moved from To Do straight to Done, and the agent-side support desk and support desk layout items started (UC-261, UC-339). Shivam Dhoundiyal also holds two new features with no due dates: a Marketplace Communication Hub (UC-423 to UC-427) and the RFQ design implementation and API integration (UC-428 to UC-433). The chatbot fixes UC-413 to UC-419 are still Ready for Prod, and the marketing lead capture (UC-57) is in Dev Testing. 75 items are past due, down from 81.

programmes.name: Uvation Pulse
programmes.headline: Naveen Jangid closed on-prem production deployment (PULSE-10) on 30 Oct and Sarath Chandra closed the production deployment pipeline set-up (PULSE-333), together with the Pulse pipeline work on the Devops board (IN-1165 to IN-1168). No PULSE item is past due. Most PULSE tickets were last touched in a bulk update on 29 Sep and are outside the 30-day window. Anshul Bhargava's Interactive AI Factory tasks sit on the PRD board, outside this report's boards.

programmes.name: Atlas CRM
programmes.headline: On 12 Nov Saurabh Jain closed the CRM roles, lead ownership and assignment history schema (ATLAS-306), the admin board and per-rep overview (ATLAS-312), the schema migration and its tests (ATLAS-320, ATLAS-321), the admin overview and assignment wiring (ATLAS-336, ATLAS-337) and the hybrid RAG story (ATLAS-350, ATLAS-352). Saurabh Jain raised a pilot enablement story with five subtasks (ATLAS-354 to ATLAS-359, due 30 Nov): pilot scope and lead sources, automated request emails, a Book a meeting call to action and chatbot integration with Marketing and the Marketplace. Nagamuni Valluri's front-end Playwright and analytics story (ATLAS-297) moved to 30 Nov. Most of the CRM roles and Kanban subtasks (ATLAS-318 to ATLAS-349) are still unassigned and due 13 Nov.

programmes.name: Web-Identity

programmes.name: Devops

The team raised its next items, mostly due 30 Nov: AKS self-hosted agents in production (IN-1237, IN-1241, IN-1246 to IN-1248, b.kumar), Docker image vulnerability scanning (IN-1238, IN-1242 to IN-1245, Sarath Chandra), private network access for the container registry (IN-1239, IN-1249 to IN-1251, k.kishore) and ongoing DevOps maintenance (IN-1240, IN-1252 to IN-1254). Sarath Chandra is monitoring ClickHouse metrics growth and production VM capacity (IN-1235, due 13 Nov). The Marketplace front-end and CMS deployments on AKS agents (IN-1219, IN-1223) are still open past their 4 and 6 Nov dates. 15 items sit in BLOCKER status and 27 are past due, unchanged.
